questions.question: Q1 - Why is this study considered a robust one?
choix: A) Statistics achieved more than 80% power.
B) This open-label trial will be appropriate for an early-stage trial to show safety and to explore within-subject changes due to treatment.
C) A multi-arm phase III trial can measure multiple treatments or dosages against the same control group.
D) This study enabled the accurate determination of the specific side effects of pembrolizumab.
E) It combines many sturdy criteria, being a phase III, 1:1, open-label, Active-Controlled Trial (ACT) with random allocation across 192 sites.

questions.question: Q2 - Do we have grounds to criticise this study?
choix: A) The study was sponsored by a large pharmaceutical company.
B) A set of paid-by Merck employees designed the trial.
C) The duration of the study may not be long enough to appreciate patients’ outcomes.
D) High- and low-risk patients (risk assessment basis) were included.
E) Adverse Events (AEs) of more severe grades were more commonly reported in the treatment arm.

questions.question: Q3 - Which inclusion criterion/ criteria can be criticised?
choix: A) Cancer had recently been diagnosed.
B) Cancer stage could be advanced.
C) All inclusion criteria are not detailed in this manuscript.
D) Cancer primary site was always the pharynx.
E) The number of participants was not even in all groups.

questions.question: Q4 - What specific limitation(s) should be highlighted?
choix: A) The efficacy & safety of pembrolizumab administered at the different stages of therapy remain difficult to determine
B) Sample sizes were small in some subgroups, making the efficacy of perioperative pembrolizumab in the subgroup of participants with a CPS < 1 impossible to confirm.
C) The baseline characteristics of the global population were not comparable between the two groups.
D) The dose of radiation and the use of cisplatin were ultimately determined by the investigator according to their local guidelines
E) Randomised Clinical Trials (RCTs) have designers hide actual results from researchers

questions.question: Q5 - Which of the following statement(s) is (are) true?
choix: A) The monitoring period for Adverse Events (AEs) was longer in the pembrolizumab arm.
B) At publication time, follow-up was still ongoing, weakening inferences or potential generalisation results.
C) Median therapy was 3 times longer in the control group (9 months), while close to 3 months in the pembrolizumab group.
D) For the CPS-10 population, median event-free survival was close to 60 months in the pembrolizumab arm compared to almost 1/3 of that time in the control group.
E) 36 months was the initial cut-off date for reaching primary endpoints

questions.question: Q6 - Select the correct statement(s) about figures in the following list.
choix: A) The sample size was planned such that the CPS-10 population would provide the trial with approximately 94.9% power
B) After 66 months, participants in any (PD-L1 CPS ≥ 10 and PD-L1 CPS ≥ 1) active group fared better (alive & event free) than the control arm by at least 13 points each.
C) After 66 months, participants in any (PD-L1 CPS ≥ 10 and PD-L1 CPS ≥ 1) active group fared better (alive & event free) than the control arm by at least 13 points each.
D) Discontinuation due to AEs and SAEs occurred twice more in the active group than in the control group
E) Conventional treatment made of surgery plus radiotherapy - with & without cisplatin- ends up in relapse in 1/3 patients within 12 months & less than a third will still be event free after 5 years

questions.question: Q7 - Select the data - only if detailed in the article.
choix: A) The 2 cycles of neo-adjuvant pembrolizumab were injected 3 weeks apart, before initiating the 15 cycles of pembrolizumab.
B) The study cut-off date was in late summer 2024.
C) The study randomised patients for 58 months.
D) Follow-up lasted 7 years across 24 countries.
E) Patients were 79% male, with a smoking (71%) and/ or alcohol-use (69%) history.

questions.question: Q8 - Fill in the diagram (issued with the article) with 2 data (arrows 1 & 2):
choix: A) 1- immunotherapy 3 cycles + radiotherapy +/ cisplatin 2 - radiotherapy +/- cisplatin
B) 1-Pembrolizumab 3 cycles + radiotherapy +/ chemotherapy 2 - Radiotherapy +/- chemotherapy
C) 1 - Pembrolizumab 3 cycles 2 - radiotherapy
D) 1 - pembrozilumab 3 cycles + radiotherapy 2 - Low-Dose RadioTherapy
E) 1 - pembrozilumab 2 cycles + radiotherapy 2 - standard radiotherapy

questions.question: Q9 - (language command question) At the beginning of the “Results” section (page 40), we read: “Less than 5% of all the participants had a CPS of less than 1.” The underlined word ("less"), from a grammar perspective, would advantageously be replaced by…
choix: A) Fewer
B) More
C) Both
D) The least
E) None of these options, as“less” is the only grammatical possibility.
